summary: No security findings. The change is limited to range selection in src/advice/ranges.ts: rangesFor now delegates to referenceSizeOf, which maps 2 / 3-7 / 8-10 dealt-in seats to bundled, import-validated range data and throws RangeError for anything else (fails closed rather than returning partial data). The only input is the engine-derived dealt-in count; no user, file, network or env input reaches the new code. The observed-stats path keeps its existing validation. No new dependencies (package.json only adds a test file to the opt-in test:slow script), no randomness added (playtests seeded), no secrets, logging, file or injection surface. The new slow playtest is opt-in behind TLH_SLOW_TESTS, so no CI resource concern.
